title: Do Not Look for Signs Elsewhere

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "'Do not eat any meat with the blood still in it. Do not practise divination or seek omens. Do not cut the hair at the sides of your head or clip off the edges of your beard. Do not cut your bodies for the dead or put tattoo marks on yourselves. I am the LORD.'" - Lev 19:26-28 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
These commands are grouped together because they share one thing: they were all religious practices of the surrounding nations. Cutting the hair in a particular pattern, gashing the body in mourning, marking the skin — these were how Canaanites worshipped their gods and mourned their dead.

God is not issuing a general ruling on hairstyles. He is separating His people from pagan worship. The specific customs mattered because of what they meant to everyone watching.

Believers today differ on how these verses apply — some Christians see a lasting principle about the body, others see a culture-bound prohibition tied to idolatry. Sincere believers land in different places, and we should not divide over it.

But the heart of it is clear, and it is in the middle: do not practise divination or seek omens. God's people are not to look for guidance anywhere but God.

That temptation is very much alive. Horoscopes read half-seriously. Fortune tellers consulted in a crisis. Endless searching for a sign when what God has already said is plain enough.

God has spoken. In these last days he has spoken to us by his Son (Heb 1:2). You do not need omens. You have His Word and His Spirit.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you look for guidance other than God's Word?
2. Have you treated something like horoscopes as harmless entertainment?
3. What is God already saying to you that you have not yet obeyed?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You that You have spoken clearly in Your Son and Your Word. Keep me from looking elsewhere for guidance, and give me contentment with what You have said. Amen.
